in_marathi.name: Ashoka
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Without sorrow, without regret
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ashoka हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ashoka means 'without sorrow' or 'without regret'. This name is derived from the ancient emperor Ashoka, known for his acts of compassion and spreading of Buddhism across India.

in_bengali.name: Ashoka
